shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' && rg --files"
/bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md && echo '---' && cat package.json && echo '---' && ls -la node_modules/next/dist/docs || true && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -n 80"

/bin/bash -lc "echo 'Inspecting current Pages Router files and shared components.' && sed -n '1,220p' pages/_app.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' pages/_document.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' pages/_error.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' pages/404.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' pages/index.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' pages/blog/index.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' pages/blog/'[id]'.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' pages/api/posts/index.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' pages/api/posts/'[id]'.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' components/AppProvider.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' styles/globals.css && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- layouts/pages ---' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md && echo '--- route handlers ---' && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md && echo '--- error handling ---' && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/10-error-handling.md && echo '--- fetching data ---' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && echo '--- revalidating ---' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/09-revalidating.md"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- page convention ---' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md && echo '--- dynamic routes ---' && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/dynamic-routes.md && echo '--- route handlers convention ---' && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md && echo '--- not-found convention ---' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md && echo '--- error convention ---' && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md && echo '--- metadata convention ---' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-metadata/index.md"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' pages/blog/'[id]'.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' pages/api/posts/index.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' pages/api/posts/'[id]'.js"

/bin/bash -lc "echo 'Searching docs for exact typed signatures…' && rg -n \"params: Promise|export async function GET|Route Handler|notFound\\(|error\\.tsx|global-not-found|generateStaticParams|dynamicParams|fallback\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/*.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/*.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/*.md | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "echo 'dynamic-routes snippets:' && rg -n \"generateStaticParams|dynamicParams|params: Promise|notFound\\(\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/dynamic-routes.md | sed -n '1,200p' && echo '--- route snippets ---' && rg -n \"export async function GET|Route Handlers|params: Promise|NextRequest|NextResponse|context\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '--- not-found snippets ---' && rg -n \"global-not-found|notFound\\(|not-found\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md | sed -n '1,200p' && echo '--- error snippets ---' && rg -n \"'use client'|error\\.tsx|global-error|retry|reset\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md && echo '---' && sed -n '260,520p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/dynamic-routes.md && echo '---' && sed -n '260,520p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/dynamic-routes.md && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "''^---|headers'"\\(\\)|from 'next/headers'|headers is an\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md"
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p app/ui app/blog/'[id]' app/api/posts/'[id]'"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config && rg -n "revalidate|dynamic|fetchCache|runtime|deprecated|cache" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/*.md'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"generateMetadata\\(|params: Promise\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-metadata.md | sed -n '1,260p' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-metadata.md"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/fetch.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "next/router|next/head|getStaticProps|getServerSideProps|getStaticPaths|_app|_document|pages/api" . && ls -la app && find app -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort'
/bin/bash -lc "rm pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js pages/blog/'[id]'.js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/api/posts/'[id]'.js"
/bin/bash -lc "rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && echo 'pages directory removed'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && echo '---' && rg -n \"next/head|next/router|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|pages/api|_app|_document|_error\" . || true && echo '---' && find app components -maxdepth 5 -type f | sort && echo '--- tsconfig ---' && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,240p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/blog/page.tsx | sed -n '1,240p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/blog/'[id]'/page.tsx | sed -n '1,320p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/blog/'[id]'/loading.tsx | sed -n '1,80p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/api/posts/route.ts | sed -n '1,260p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/api/posts/'[id]'/route.ts | sed -n '1,320p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/not-found.tsx | sed -n '1,120p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/error.tsx | sed -n '1,160p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/global-error.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/ui/NavigateToBlogButton.tsx | sed -n '1,120p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/ui/ViewPostButton.tsx | sed -n '1,120p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/ui/BackButton.tsx | sed -n '1,120p' && echo '---' && nl -ba components/AppProvider.tsx | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && echo '--- package.json ---' && git diff -- package.json && echo '--- tsconfig.json ---' && git diff -- tsconfig.json && echo '--- app/error.tsx ---' && git diff -- app/error.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:package.json'
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && if [ -f next-env.d.ts ]; then echo '--- next-env.d.ts ---'; cat next-env.d.ts; fi"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '\"next\"\\s*:' package-lock.json | head -n 20 && rg -n '\"node_modules/next\"|\"version\"\\s*:\\s*\"16\\.4\\.0-canary\\.9\"' package-lock.json | head -n 40"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/blog/'[id]'/page.tsx | sed -n '1,260p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/api/posts/route.ts | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/api/posts/'[id]'/route.ts | sed -n '1,260p'"
